workPayroll.statutoryBody: Sales OS is a payroll register. PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS are not computed here; HR or Finance add them as manual deduction components or adjustment lines. Sales OS never moves money.
workPayroll.restrictedBody: Salary and payslip data is visible only to Founder, Finance and HR. Every export is audited.

runs.title: Payroll runs
runs.description: One run per month: calculate from closed attendance, review, approve, then record the external payout.
runs.createDescription: Pick the month. The run starts as a draft and is calculated once the month has ended and its days are closed.
runs.emptyBody: Create the first run once a month has ended.
runs.emptyFiltered: No payroll runs with this status

run.title: Payroll {month}
run.notFound: No payroll run for this month
run.notFoundBody: Create the run from the payroll runs page first.
run.workingDays: {n, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} in the month
run.calcHint: Calculate reads closed attendance days and approved leave only. Recalculating keeps manual adjustment lines.
run.separation: The person who prepared a run cannot approve it.
run.noPayslipsBody: Calculate the run to create payslips for employees with a salary structure.
run.sendBackTitle: Send the run back to draft?
run.sendBackBody: The run returns to draft, employees lose access to their payslips until it is approved again.
run.cancelBody: A cancelled month can be re-opened as a new draft. A paid run cannot be cancelled.
run.reasonHint: At least 3 characters. Recorded in the audit log.
run.paidBody: Enter the bank or UPI reference of the payout you made outside Sales OS. This only records it; no money is moved.
run.referenceHint: At least 3 characters, for example a UTR number.
run.approveBody: Employees will be able to open their own payslip once the run is approved. Figures can no longer be changed unless the run is sent back.
run.notClosedTitle: This month cannot be calculated yet
run.notEnded: The month has not ended (it ends on {monthEnd}).
run.daysNotClosed: Some employee days are not closed. The nightly day-close job or an HR attendance correction must complete them first.
run.moreEmployees: More employees are affected than shown.

adjust.title: Adjustments for {name}
adjust.description: Manual lines (bonus, arrears, recovery, statutory items). Allowed while the run is draft or calculated. Each line is audited without amounts.
adjust.label: Label
adjust.amountHint: Positive amount with up to 2 decimals.
adjust.locked: This run is {status}; adjustments can no longer be changed.

structures.title: Salary structures
structures.description: The monthly salary components of each employee. Versions are append-only: a change is a new version with an effective date.
structures.upcoming: {n, plural, one {# future version} other {# future versions}}
structures.formDescription: Amounts are monthly. Add PF, ESI, professional tax or TDS yourself as DEDUCTION components; Sales OS does not compute them.
structures.historyDescription: Every version ever saved. Versions are never edited or deleted.

errors.amountFormat: Enter a positive amount with up to 2 decimals

payslips.title: My payslips
payslips.description: Your payslips appear here after the Founder approves the payroll run.
payslips.emptyBody: Payslips appear after the monthly payroll run is approved.
payslips.footer: Register payslip. Statutory deductions (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS) are not calculated by Sales OS; only the lines shown above apply.
